design_description: A bold, high-energy design built around oversized chevron graphics that create constant movement and visual impact. Alternating royal blue and metallic gold zigzag bands flow across the navy base, giving the jersey a dynamic, modern identity with a premium finish. The white collar and sleeve cuffs provide clean contrast, while gold shoulder accents reinforce the luxurious color palette. The repeating pattern is balanced by a clean central sponsor area, allowing the graphics to remain striking without overwhelming the composition. Overall, the jersey feels powerful, energetic, and contemporary, blending classic sporting chevrons with a bold geometric aesthetic.
